Theme

Latin word

in

in (+ ablative)

preposition with the ablative

among (one of a number); at (a place one is in); in, on (where something is); into, in (where to); on (resting on); onto, on (where to); to (a country, a region)

In this lexicon

  • among

    also used · classical · Verg. E. 8.56: Orpheus in silvīs, inter delphīnas Arīōn

  • at

    the recommended word · classical · Gell. 11.2.5: vestīrī … in forō honestē mōs erat; Sen. Ep. 47.16: in forō et in cūriā

  • in

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. C. 2.16.13–14: splendet in mēnsā tenuī salīnum; Vulg. Jo. 14.2: In domō Patris meī mānsiōnēs multae sunt

  • into

    the recommended word · classical · Vulg. Lc. 10.5: In quamcumque domum intrāveritis; Plin. NH 9.86: omnia in domum conportat

  • on

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. C. 2.16.13–14: splendet in mēnsā tenuī salīnum; Petr. 29.1: in pariete erat pictus

  • on

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 34: in equum omnīnō nōn ascendere

  • to

    also used · classical · Vulg. Gen. 28.15: redūcam tē in terram hanc
